mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates by reducing the risk-free rate, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any macroeconomic regime.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces earnings multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in housing starts (HOUST) indicate deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending capacity, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when UNRATE rises and HOUST falls in more than 60% of cases without negative 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 350,000 million dollars (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 350000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth is not associated with positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals economic weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with CPIAUCSL above 3.0 indicates aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 3.0 in more than 60% of cases without negative 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 600,000 units (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 600 over a 3-year rolling window.
